page.notes: Printed hyphens kept at line ends: De-us, dire-ctam, Proto-mar-tyris. The reference "7." sits below the last line at the right; it is read as the end of "Act: 7." and kept in the paragraph. "ego sum" in the Johannine quotation is printed in a form I read with doubt, and "Franc:" is uncertain. The edge of the adjacent page at the right is not transcribed.
